message.content: Based on the information provided, Helios praises "Returnal" for its visual storytelling, atmosphere shifts, and constant tension. Helios also speaks highly of "Horizon Forbidden West," describing it as having a stunning world and engaging gameplay mechanics, though this does not specifically address character connection.
